infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Comly uses your photo library so you can choose a profile photo or upload photos related to a job listing.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Comly may save images you create or upload, such as profile or job photos, to your photo library only when you request it.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Comly uses your camera so you can take a profile photo or add photos related to a job listing.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Comly uses your approximate location to show nearby local help opportunities and help customers post jobs in the correct area.
